pdfinfo.Title: Mass, Fine Structure Constant, and the Classification of Elementary Particles by Masses
pdfinfo.Subject: The equations of motion of physical bodies are given, the characteristic parameters of which become the basis for determining a fundamental property of all matter—“mass”. The equations of motion are characterized by two constants, the derivative of one of which is the fine structure constant. Using these constants, energy scales are compiled, which are the basis for classifying particles by mass.
pdfinfo.Keywords: Mass, Energy, Structure, Quantum Numbers, Elementary Particles
pdfinfo.Author: Khachatur Kirakosyan
